requirements.requirement: The system must define a clinical trial recency schema that includes the field last_update_date as a date type.
The system must define the field days_since_update as a non-negative integer derived from last_update_date.
The system must define the field normalized_recency_score as a numeric value bounded between 0 and 1 inclusive.
The system must define the field missing_data_flag as a boolean indicating absence or invalidity of recency data.
The system must ensure the schema is serializable to JSON and compatible with existing evaluation pipeline response structures.
The system must map last_update_date directly from ClinicalTrials.gov API response fields without transformation of semantic meaning.
The system must define a scoring contract that specifies normalized_recency_score is computed solely from days_since_update.
The system must include explicit documentation in the schema contract describing each field and its purpose.
The system must support null or missing last_update_date values without breaking schema validation.
The system must set missing_data_flag to true when last_update_date is null, missing, or malformed.
The system must define that normalized_recency_score defaults to 0 when missing_data_flag is true.
The system must ensure the schema aligns with existing naming conventions used in other clinical trial measure schemas.
The system must validate that days_since_update cannot be negative and reject or correct invalid values.
The system must define the scoring contract such that more recent updates correspond to higher normalized_recency_score values.
The system must ensure the schema can be extended in future without breaking backward compatibility of existing fields.
